% Amazon Reviews 2023 as a scalar-text TSS illustration.
% Table~\ref{tab:amazon-continuous-batches} is auto-generated.

\paragraph{Amazon continuous batches.}
The typed shift stepsize does not require three modality heads.
Take Amazon Reviews 2023 and treat nine product categories as consecutive
batches $W=0,\ldots,8$ (gift cards, digital music, beauty, software,
subscription boxes, musical instruments, magazines, handmade, fashion).
$X$ is a TF-IDF of title plus body, with the vocabulary frozen on batch 0.
$Y$ is the 1--5 star rating.
A linear MSE probe is trained online: predict the arriving batch, then take
SGD steps with the current $\eta$.

The batch-relationship heatmap is the same $\mathrm{cosine}(B_i,B_j)$ object as
the MSR-VTT modality boards, on one text head.
Sparse TF-IDF pairwise cosine is near zero; the relationship is the cosine of
category-mean vectors, $R_{ij}=\cos(\bar x_i,\bar x_j)$.
Covariate intensity on the hop the trainer actually walks is read off that
heatmap,
\begin{equation}
  \hat c_t
  =
  1-R_{t-1,t}
  =
  1-\cos(\bar x_{t-1},\bar x_t).
\end{equation}
Concept intensity $\hat\delta$ remains two-fold excess ridge MSE after
mean-aligning $X$ (a location shift in $P(X)$ is removed; a change in
$P(Y\mid X)$ is not).
The next-epoch stepsize is the same formula as on MSR-VTT,
\begin{equation}
  \eta^{\star}
  =
  \eta_0\,
  \frac{1+\beta\hat\delta/s}{1+\lambda\hat c\, s},
  \qquad
  s=\sqrt{n_{\mathrm{iter}}},
\end{equation}
with a quiet hold when both channels are off.
Train batch $t$ with $\eta^{(t)}$; then set $\eta^{(t+1)}$.

Comparators are scalar clocks of $t$ or of the loss: constant, cosine,
plateau (halve after two non-improving online-MSE rounds), and Polyak
($\eta$ proportional to the current MSE --- the wrong sign under pure
covariate shift).
inv-$c$ is the covariate half of TSS ($\beta=0$).

The pre-specified metrics are online MSE, BWT (MSE on batch 0 after the
stream), and regret against the hindsight-best constant $\eta$ in the same
box TSS is allowed to play in, $[0.04,\,2.5\eta_0]$.
Unconstrained larger constants can still cut online MSE: the linear probe
is underfitting, which is not a scheduler ranking.
Category sequence is a domain stream, not a timestamp stream: $\hat c$ is
expected to be live, so a typed map should not chase $X$.
Do not read this as a retrieval or ranking evaluation.
The numerical comparison is Table~\ref{tab:amazon-continuous-batches}.
